answer: Give every new identity a capped trial zone: a shallow lagoon where it can only handle tiny, low-value jobs, no matter how many accounts one operator spawns. To leave it, the identity must complete a verified voyage of useful work — deliveries confirmed by independent counterparties, each staked with a small deposit that is burned if the work is fake. A violet badge marks identities that survived the voyage with their stake intact, so counterparties can price trust at a glance instead of trusting a name alone.
